title-screen.alt: The title screen on a near-black background with faint blue stars. "Pattern Break" in large cyan pixel letters with a magenta shadow, over a row of small LED segments shading from green to red. Below it, a menu in small pixel type: "Play" in amber with an amber ">" before it, then "Practice" with "The_Epic_Chip", "Difficulty" with "Normal", and "Jukebox", in grey. Under the menu, "Music: The_Epic_Chip by Drozerix. Public Domain.", and at the bottom two lines of help: "Up and down choose. Left and right change. Enter selects." and "In play: arrows or WASD fly, Esc pauses."
title-screen.caption: The title menu. Not used in the README.

gameplay.alt: A frame of play in an LED cavern. Columns of small square LED segments hang from the top edge and rise from the bottom edge, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, leaving a dark passage about a third of the screen high across the middle. The tips step up and down from column to column. A small cyan ship with a magenta engine flame flies on the left through the passage, with faint blue stars behind.
gameplay.caption: Pattern Break at 21.5 seconds into the test song on normal, with the ship flown by the autopilot.

gameplay-clip.alt: Four seconds of play in an LED cavern. Columns of square LED segments, lit green at the screen edges through yellow and orange to red at their tips, hang from the top and rise from the bottom and scroll from right to left, one column per row of the song. The dark passage between them narrows on the beats and drifts up and down the screen with the tune. A small cyan ship with a flickering engine flame follows the passage, and faint blue stars drift more slowly behind.
gameplay-clip.caption: Four seconds of the test song on normal, flown by the autopilot through the sim.
